notes.title: Improved Sex Animations & Hunter Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello!

This small update brings important improvements to the game:


 🔥 Enhanced animations in sex scenes – now they look smoother and more natural.
 🛠 Fixed the hunter's jumping bug – now the hunter jumps correctly in the ruined temple location on the cliff.


Thank you for playing and supporting us! Your feedback helps us make the game even better.

notes.title: Catch Me Update
notes.notes:
What's New?
Added No NSFW Mode – a new mode is now available in the game:

 Players collect baskets and compete in a separate leaderboard.
 Designed for streamers and those who just want to run without sex content.
 Loading screens no longer contain NSFW images in this mode.


Hunter AI Improvements – we've adjusted the hunter’s behavior:

 Now it gets stuck less often when choosing a route.
 Handles complex obstacles more efficiently.


If you find a bug, please report it in the Bug Reports section. Your feedback helps us improve the game.
